last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Tue 10-20 late morning, chat only, all on the page (no audio). Opening: kilambalaamaa + oru maasam iruppom named as his; Freeya vidunga (his 10-19 push reply) praised as Kovai; MAP shown (week 3, Paati 75); varusham = varsha/rain lore. Sweep-of-one on his claim: ulla/veliya/thambi read right in sentences (recorded --read); dropped 'en' (my) in 'Ivan en thambi' - taught. Produced 'Senjom, saapten' (we made it, I ate it) - senjom hinted (it was on the map), joke landed. KITCHEN (Anna-played text exchange at real table density, NOT the Ep98 tape - he called Ep98 mostly-English and hokey on 10-16): Paati back early, Karthi 'naanga tea pottom', Athai caves 'naanga biryani senjom', Paati 'enakku ellaam theriyum... Mama kitta vaangina panam, meedhi enga?'. Read results: Q3 gist right (secret's out) - ellaam theriyum mirrored onto his gift line enakku onnum theriyaadhu; Q1 read pottom as 'going to get tea' (finished -tom read as future; taught pottom vs poduvom); Q2 missed kelu (ask) + -nu quote ('make an announcement'). Taught kelu, -nu as quotation marks. Changed example 1 ('naan dhaan senjen'-nu sonnaan): -nu QUOTE PLACED RIGHT unaided (first time; it beat him on the 10-15 voice note) but person tails wrong: senjen read as we, sonnaan as they. Taught the tail table senjen/senjom/senjaan/senjaanga. Changed example 2 (Athai 'illa, naanga dhaan senjom'-nu sonnaanga): -om=we RIGHT, -aanga=they/Athai RIGHT, quote RIGHT (table was on screen = supported); read illa as negating the verb ('we didn't make it') - taught: illa up front = 'no, you're wrong'; the verb's own negative is the -la tail (senjala). CARRY: person tails (-en/-om/-aan/-aanga) on ONE root are the live recognition gap, page-only so far - next is BY EAR. illa-scope vs -la tail. M97 'Exact Change' still unheard. Oct 23 tenth-anniversary line ('Namma kalyanam aagi pathu varusham aachu') offered, his to take - the date is THIS WEEK. Receptive check never run by ear. Live slips: past-tense, person-tail, nga-has-no-address, noun-for-verb, respect-nga, come-go-direction, default-la-tail, literary-twin. VAA stays out of chat production until unannounced ambush. Karthi ambush of 'enakku onnum theriyaadhu' still unspent. NEXT: different room (clinic/errand/terrace/phone), table density in Tamil not English-with-sprinkles (his 10-16 verdict on Ep98); hear the person tails on one root by ear - who did it, from the tail alone. Hook: Karthi's debt to Mama is now OUT - what does Paati do with it?
